SELECT ZZ.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY ZZ.AMD_DT DESC) rownum FROM (
SELECT /* com.kt.openapi.web.api.dao.ApiSearchDAO.selMainList */
ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY A.AMD_DT DESC) rownum,
A.API_SPC_NO, A.API_SPC_ID, A.VER, B.API_NM, B.API_NO, B.API_PATH, COALESCE(A.API_DESC,'') AS API_DESC, COALESCE(A.AMDR,'') AS AMDR, COALESCE((SELECT MBR_NM FROM KOA_TB_MBR B WHERE A.AMDR = B.MBR_ID ),'') AS AMDR_NM, A.AMD_DT, TO_CHAR(A.AMD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS AMD_DT_STR, A.REG_STTUS_CD, COALESCE(D.CD_NM,'') AS REG_STTUS_CD_NM, A.SYS_ID, COALESCE(S.SYS_NM,'') AS SYS_ID_NM, A.API_NM AS API_SPC_NM, B.API_DESC AS API_DEF_DESC, B.METHOD_CD, COALESCE(C.CD_NM,'') AS METHOD_NM, B.SHOW_STATUS_CD, REPLACE(B.API_NM, '@@', '') AS F_API_NM, B.API_DESC AS F_API_DESC FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC A INNER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF B ON (A.API_SPC_NO = B.API_SPC_NO) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD D ON (A.REG_STTUS_CD = D.COMN_CD AND D.GROUP_CD = 'APIREG1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD C ON (B.METHOD_CD = C.COMN_CD AND C.GROUP_CD = 'MTHTYP1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM S ON (S.SYS_ID = A.SYS_ID) WHERE (COALESCE(A.DEL_YN,'N') = 'N') AND NOT((A.TMPLT_YN != 'N') AND (A.TMPLT_YN IS NOT NULL))
AND (COALESCE(A.SHOW_YN,'Y') = 'Y') AND (A.REG_STTUS_CD = 'APIREG1030')
AND (A.REG_STTUS_CD = #{regSttusCd})
AND ( (B.API_DESC LIKE '%' || #{} || '%') OR (B.API_NM LIKE '%' || #{} || '%') OR (A.API_NM LIKE '%' || #{} || '%') OR (B.API_NO IN (SELECT API_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM C WHERE (C.PARAM_NM LIKE '%' || #{} || '%'))) )
AND (A.SYS_ID NOT IN ('SHUB' , 'IOTMAKERS' , 'UCLOUDBIZ' , 'GIGAGENIE' , 'OLLEHMAP'))
AND (A.SYS_ID = #{sysId})
AND (A.API_SPC_NO IN (SELECT B.API_SPC_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_CTGRY B WHERE (B.CTGRY_NM = #{ctgryNm})))
AND (A.SYS_ID NOT IN ('SHUB','AUTHENTI','INFRA','APPLICATI'))
AND (A.SYS_ID = #{sysId})
AND (UPPER(B.API_NM) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%')
AND (UPPER(B.API_DESC) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%')
AND ( (UPPER(B.API_NM) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%') OR (UPPER(B.API_DESC) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%') OR (B.API_NO IN (SELECT API_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM C WHERE C.PARAM_NM LIKE '%' || #{} || '%')) )
UNION ALL
SELECT B.API_SPC_NO, B.API_SPC_ID, B.VER, C.API_NM, C.API_NO, C.API_PATH, COALESCE(B.API_DESC,'') AS API_DESC, COALESCE(B.AMDR,'') AS AMDR, COALESCE(M.MBR_NM,'') AS AMDR_NM, B.AMD_DT, TO_CHAR(B.AMD_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS AMD_DT_STR, B.REG_STTUS_CD, COALESCE(D.CD_NM,'') AS REG_STTUS_CD_NM, AAA.SYS_ID, AAA.SYS_NM AS SYS_ID_NM, B.API_NM AS API_SPC_NM, C.API_DESC AS API_DEF_DESC, C.METHOD_CD, COALESCE(D1.CD_NM,'') AS METHOD_NM, C.SHOW_STATUS_CD, REPLACE(C.API_NM, '@@', '') AS F_API_NM, C.API_DESC AS F_API_DESC FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM AAA LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT AA.* ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY AA.API_SPC_ID ORDER BY AA.API_SPC_NO DESC ) RN ,BB.SORT_ODRG ,BB.API_STATUS_CD ,BB.API_SUMRY ,BB.USE_APPY_URL ,BB.HTM_TAG_NM FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC AA INNER JOIN V2OA_TB_SPC_INFO BB ON AA.API_SPC_ID = BB.API_SPC_ID WHERE (AA.DEL_YN = 'N')
AND (COALESCE(AA.SHOW_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') AND (AA.REG_STTUS_CD = 'APIREG1030')
AND (AA.REG_STTUS_CD = #{regSttusCd})
AND NOT((AA.TMPLT_YN != 'N') AND (AA.TMPLT_YN IS NOT NULL)) ) B ON AAA.SYS_ID = B.SYS_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF C ON (B.API_SPC_NO = C.API_SPC_NO) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD D ON (B.REG_STTUS_CD = D.COMN_CD AND D.GROUP_CD = 'APIREG1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_COMN_CD D1 ON (C.METHOD_CD = D1.COMN_CD AND D1.GROUP_CD = 'MTHTYP1000') LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_MBR M ON (B.AMDR = M.MBR_ID) WHERE (AAA.SORT_ODRG > 0) AND (AAA.SORT_ODRG IS NOT NULL) AND (B.RN = 1) AND (C.USE_YN = 'Y') AND (C.SHOW_STATUS_CD != '') AND (AAA.SYS_ID IN ('SHUB','AUTHENTI','INFRA','APPLICATI'))
AND (AAA.SYS_ID = #{sysId})
AND (UPPER(C.API_NM) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%')
AND (UPPER(C.API_DESC) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%')
AND ( (UPPER(C.API_NM) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%') OR (UPPER(C.API_DESC) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%') OR (C.API_NO IN ( SELECT API_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM P WHERE (P.PARAM_NM LIKE '%' || #{} || '%') ) ) )
) ZZ

SELECT SUM(ZZ.CNT) AS CNT FROM (
SELECT /* com.kt.openapi.web.api.dao.ApiSearchDAO.selMainListTotalCnt */ COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC A , KOA_TB_API_DEF B WHERE (A.API_SPC_NO = B.API_SPC_NO) AND (COALESCE(A.DEL_YN,'N') = 'N') AND NOT((A.TMPLT_YN != 'N') AND (A.TMPLT_YN IS NOT NULL))
AND (COALESCE(A.SHOW_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') AND (A.REG_STTUS_CD = 'APIREG1030')
AND (A.REG_STTUS_CD = #{regSttusCd})
AND ( (B.API_DESC LIKE '%' || #{} || '%') OR (B.API_NM LIKE '%' || #{} || '%') OR (A.API_NM LIKE '%' || #{} || '%') OR (B.API_NO IN (SELECT API_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM C WHERE (C.PARAM_NM LIKE '%' || #{} || '%'))) )
AND (A.SYS_ID NOT IN ('SHUB' , 'IOTMAKERS' , 'UCLOUDBIZ' , 'GIGAGENIE' , 'OLLEHMAP'))
AND (A.SYS_ID = #{sysId})
AND (A.API_SPC_NO IN (SELECT B.API_SPC_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_CTGRY B WHERE (B.CTGRY_NM = #{ctgryNm})))
AND (A.SYS_ID NOT IN ('SHUB','AUTHENTI','INFRA','APPLICATI'))
AND (A.SYS_ID = #{sysId})
AND (UPPER(B.API_NM) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%')
AND (UPPER(B.API_DESC) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%')
AND ( (UPPER(B.API_NM) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%') OR (UPPER(B.API_DESC) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%') OR (B.API_NO IN (SELECT API_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM C WHERE C.PARAM_NM LIKE '%' || #{} || '%')) )
UNION ALL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM AAA LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT AA.* ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY AA.API_SPC_ID ORDER BY AA.API_SPC_NO DESC ) RN ,BB.SORT_ODRG ,BB.API_STATUS_CD ,BB.API_SUMRY ,BB.USE_APPY_URL ,BB.HTM_TAG_NM FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC AA INNER JOIN V2OA_TB_SPC_INFO BB ON (AA.API_SPC_ID = BB.API_SPC_ID) WHERE (AA.DEL_YN = 'N')
AND (COALESCE(AA.SHOW_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') AND (AA.REG_STTUS_CD = 'APIREG1030')
AND (AA.REG_STTUS_CD = #{regSttusCd})
AND ((AA.TMPLT_YN = 'N') OR (AA.TMPLT_YN IS NULL)) ) B ON (AAA.SYS_ID = B.SYS_ID) LEFT OUTER JOIN KOA_TB_API_DEF C ON (B.API_SPC_NO = C.API_SPC_NO) WHERE (AAA.SORT_ODRG > 0) AND (AAA.SORT_ODRG IS NOT NULL) AND (B.RN = 1) AND (C.USE_YN = 'Y') AND (C.SHOW_STATUS_CD != '') AND AAA.SYS_ID IN ('SHUB','AUTHENTI','INFRA','APPLICATI')
AND (AAA.SYS_ID = #{sysId})
AND (UPPER(C.API_NM) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%')
AND (UPPER(C.API_DESC) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%')
AND ( UPPER(C.API_NM) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%' OR UPPER(C.API_DESC) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%' OR (C.API_NO IN ( SELECT API_NO FROM KOA_TB_API_PARAM P WHERE (UPPER(P.PARAM_NM) LIKE '%' + UPPER(#{searchKeyword}) + '%') ) ) )
) ZZ

SELECT /* com.kt.openapi.web.api.dao.ApiSearchDAO.selMainCateList */ A.SYS_ID, B.CTGRY_NM FROM KOA_TB_API_SPC A , KOA_TB_API_CTGRY B WHERE A.API_SPC_NO = B.API_SPC_NO AND A.REG_STTUS_CD = 'APIREG1030' AND COALESCE(A.DEL_YN,'N') = 'N' AND COALESCE(A.SHOW_YN,'Y')= 'Y' AND NOT(A.TMPLT_YN != 'N' AND A.TMPLT_YN IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY A.SYS_ID , B.CTGRY_NM ORDER BY A.SYS_ID ASC , B.CTGRY_NM ASC
SELECT /* com.kt.openapi.web.api.dao.ApiSearchDAO.selMainSysList */ A.* FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM A ORDER BY A.SYS_ID ASC
/* com.kt.openapi.web.api.dao.ApiSearchDAO.selSystemList */ SELECT SYS_ID ,SYS_NM ,URL ,REG_DT ,REGR ,AMD_DT ,AMDR FROM KOA_TB_API_SYSTEM ORDER BY SORT_ODRG DESC
